items.definitionEn: Unified Diagnostic Services, standardized by ISO 14229.
items.explanationVi: UDS là giao thức chẩn đoán tiêu chuẩn ISO 14229 dùng để giao tiếp và chẩn đoán ECU.
items.questionEn: What does UDS stand for?

items.definitionEn: A diagnostic protocol for communicating with vehicle ECUs.
items.explanationVi: UDS tạo cửa sổ giao tiếp với ECU để đọc lỗi, đọc data, flash, test actuator và security.
items.questionEn: What is the main purpose of UDS?

items.definitionEn: UDS can run over CAN, Ethernet, or FlexRay.
items.explanationVi: UDS chạy trên CAN qua ISO-TP, Ethernet qua DoIP, hoặc FlexRay.
items.questionEn: Which networks can carry UDS?

items.definitionEn: Default, Programming, Extended Diagnostic, and Safety System sessions.
items.explanationVi: 4 session: 01 Default, 02 Programming, 03 Extended, 04 Safety System.
items.questionEn: What are the four UDS session types?

items.definitionEn: The default ECU session, used for reading DTCs and data.
items.explanationVi: Session mặc định khi ECU bật; đọc DTC và data nhưng không write hoặc flash.
items.questionEn: What can the Default Session do?

items.definitionEn: Session used to flash new ECU firmware.
items.explanationVi: Session 0x02 dùng để flash firmware mới và cần security unlock trước.
items.questionEn: What is the Programming Session used for?

items.definitionEn: Session for writing data, activating actuators, and modifying calibration.
items.explanationVi: Session 0x03 cho phép write data, activate actuator và modify calibration; cần security unlock.
items.questionEn: What is the Extended Diagnostic Session used for?

items.definitionEn: Session intended for airbag and safety-critical systems.
items.explanationVi: Session 0x04 dành cho airbag và safety-critical system; thường cần hardware key vật lý.
items.questionEn: What is the Safety System Session intended for?

items.definitionEn: A seed-key mechanism used to unlock protected ECU access.
items.explanationVi: Security Access dùng Seed-Key để bảo vệ quyền write access của ECU.
items.questionEn: What is UDS Security Access used for?

items.definitionEn: The tool requests a seed from the ECU using 27 01.
items.explanationVi: Tool gửi 27 01 để yêu cầu ECU tạo và trả về seed.
items.questionEn: How does the tool request a security seed?

items.definitionEn: The tool sends the calculated key using 27 02.
items.explanationVi: Tool tính key từ seed rồi gửi key bằng 27 02 để ECU xác minh.
items.questionEn: How does the tool send the calculated key?

items.definitionEn: A negative response indicating that the supplied key is invalid.
items.explanationVi: invalidKey nghĩa là key không đúng; ví dụ ECU trả 7F 27 35.
items.questionEn: What does NRC 35 mean in the given Security Access example?

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x10 for switching diagnostic sessions.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x10 dùng để chuyển đổi session, ví dụ 10 02 vào Programming Session.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service switches diagnostic sessions?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x11 for resetting the ECU.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x11 reset ECU; 11 01 là hardReset và 11 03 là softReset.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service resets the ECU?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x14 for clearing diagnostic trouble codes.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x14 dùng để xóa DTC; 14 FF FF FF xóa tất cả DTC.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service clears DTCs?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x19 for reading diagnostic trouble codes.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x19 dùng để đọc DTC, ví dụ 19 02 AF.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service reads DTC information?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x22 for reading data by DID.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x22 đọc data theo DID; 22 F1 90 dùng để đọc VIN.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service reads data by DID?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x2E for writing data by DID.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x2E ghi data theo DID, ví dụ 2E F1 90 [VIN bytes].
items.questionEn: Which UDS service writes data by DID?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x31 for executing ECU routines.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x31 dùng để chạy routine, ví dụ kiểm tra programming preconditions.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service executes a routine?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x34 for starting a firmware download.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x34 bắt đầu quá trình flash bằng cách yêu cầu download.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service starts a firmware download?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x36 for transferring firmware blocks.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x36 gửi từng block firmware; block size thường 256 bytes.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service transfers firmware blocks?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x37 for ending a data transfer.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x37 báo kết thúc việc gửi firmware sau khi đã gửi hết data.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service ends the firmware transfer?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: UDS service 0x3E used to keep the diagnostic session alive.
items.explanationVi: Service 0x3E giữ session sống; ví dụ 3E 00 được gửi mỗi <5 giây.
items.questionEn: Which UDS service keeps the session alive?

source.section: Các UDS Services quan trọng nhất

items.definitionEn: A sequence of UDS steps used to update ECU firmware.
items.explanationVi: Chuỗi chính: Session → Security → Preconditions → Erase → Download → Transfer → Exit → Verify → Reset.
items.questionEn: What is the main UDS flash programming sequence?

source.section: Flash Programming Sequence — Quy trình update firmware ECU

items.definitionEn: Checks required conditions before ECU programming.
items.explanationVi: Kiểm tra ignition on, voltage >10V, engine off, speed = 0 và không có safety-critical fault.
items.questionEn: What conditions are checked before programming?

source.section: Flash Programming Sequence — Check Programming Preconditions

items.definitionEn: The flash memory sector is erased before new firmware is written.
items.explanationVi: ECU xóa flash sector tương ứng; thường mất 200 ms–2 s tùy size.
items.questionEn: What happens during Erase Memory?

items.definitionEn: A routine used to verify programming integrity after transfer.
items.explanationVi: Sau Transfer Exit, ECU thực hiện CheckProgrammingIntegrity để kiểm tra firmware.
items.questionEn: What routine checks programming integrity after transfer?

source.section: Flash Programming Sequence — Transfer Exit + Verify + Reset

items.definitionEn: ISO 15765-2 transport layer for segmenting large UDS messages over CAN.
items.explanationVi: ISO-TP chia và ghép UDS message lớn hơn 8 bytes khi truyền qua CAN.
items.questionEn: What is ISO-TP used for?

items.definitionEn: ISO-TP frame used when the message is 7 bytes or less.
items.explanationVi: SF dùng khi UDS message có kích thước ≤ 7 bytes.
items.questionEn: When is an ISO-TP Single Frame used?

items.definitionEn: ISO-TP frames used when a UDS message is larger than 7 bytes.
items.explanationVi: Message >7 bytes dùng First Frame rồi các Consecutive Frames để truyền phần còn lại.
items.questionEn: Which ISO-TP frames carry messages larger than 7 bytes?

items.definitionEn: A receiver frame that tells the sender how many frames to continue sending.
items.explanationVi: FC do receiver gửi để báo sender tiếp tục gửi bao nhiêu frames.
items.questionEn: What does an ISO-TP Flow Control frame do?

items.definitionEn: A successful UDS response commonly uses the request SID plus 0x40.
items.explanationVi: Positive response thường có SID = request SID + 0x40, ví dụ 27 → 67.
items.questionEn: How is a typical UDS positive response SID formed?

items.definitionEn: A UDS response beginning with 7F and containing the request SID and NRC.
items.explanationVi: Negative response có dạng 7F [Request SID] [NRC], ví dụ 7F 27 35.
items.questionEn: What is the format of a UDS negative response?
